messages:
alex-cs: looping in the thread — FinServCo reported a subtle change in the assistant's voice after the model bump yesterday. They say answers feel more abrupt and include fewer examples/hedges. Posting the customer's minimal repro below.

alex-cs: CUSTOMER PROMPT:
`Write a short summary (3 bullets) of why multi-region inference helps latency-sensitive apps.`

alex-cs: CUSTOMER 'BEFORE' (rwd-2.4, timestamp: 2024-11-08T15:02:12Z):
- Multi-region reduces request RTT by placing compute closer to users.
- It provides regional failover for outages.
- It lets you route based on cost/latency tradeoffs and cache warmers.

alex-cs: CUSTOMER 'AFTER' (rwd-2.5, timestamp: 2024-11-09T09:17:03Z):
- Use multi-region.
- Helps when one region is down.
- Route traffic.

alex-cs: high-level: same content but noticeably shorter, less nuance/examples. Customer says this breaks their UX (loss of helpful elaboration).

maria-sr: can you paste the request id / time of the API call? also which endpoint they hit (chat vs text-gen) and any custom system messages?

alex-cs: request id: `req_0a7c2f9b` (customer provided). Called `POST /v1/chat/completions`. No custom system message on their side — only the default assistant.

alex-cs: here's the curl they ran (sanitized):
```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/chat/completions 
 -H "Authorization: Bearer <REDACTED>" 
 -H "Content-Type: application/json" 
 -d '{"model":"rwd-2.5","messages":[{"role":"user","content":"Write a short summary (3 bullets) of why multi-region inference helps latency-sensitive apps."}]}'
```

ticket-bot: Incident created: INC-54321 -> "support: finservco tone shift after model bump" :ticket:

sasha-eng-ml: thanks. quick hypotheses: 1) subtle system-prompt / assistant-style default changed in 2.5, 2) decoding default (top_p / temp / repetition penalty) might have been tightened, 3) a safety/tone-sanitizer pass was introduced. can you confirm model headers from response (`x-model-version` / `x-deployment-id`)? also push a few more examples (short/long prompts) so we can run a quick A/B.

nihal-pm: @sasha-eng-ml fyi we rolled a non-breaking config yesterday to reduce verbose hallucinations on rwd-2.5 — it adjusted the assistant_style default from `conversational` -> `direct` for some families while we evaluated false-positive hallucinations. it was intended to be subtle; retrospective could explain the "shorter" outputs.

maria-sr: copy. @nihal-pm can you paste the rollout note / PR id so we can link to engineering? I'll ask FinServCo to reproduce while pinned to rwd-2.4 and rwd-2.5 so we have side-by-side samples.

nihal-pm: PR #8342 — change in `assistant_style` default for family `rwd-2.x`. small tweak, no user-visible flag added. tagging @sasha-eng-ml for ML impact analysis.

sasha-eng-ml: sounds like the likely root. next steps: 1) collect 5 example prompts + outputs (both versions) from customer, 2) check telemetry for aggregate shift (mean tokens per response, politeness markers, avg hedging phrases), 3) check decode param diffs. I'll run a quick test by pinning to previous assistant_style and compare.

maria-sr: sent repro instructions to FinServCo — asking them to run these two commands and paste outputs:
```bash
# rwd-2.5 (current)
curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/chat/completions \
 -H "Authorization: Bearer <REDACTED>" \
 -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
 -d '{"model":"rwd-2.5","messages":[{"role":"user","content":"Write a short summary (3 bullets) of why multi-region inference helps latency-sensitive apps."}], "max_tokens": 120}'

# rwd-2.4 (pin)
curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/chat/completions \
 -H "Authorization: Bearer <REDACTED>" \
 -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
 -d '{"model":"rwd-2.4","messages":[{"role":"user","content":"Write a short summary (3 bullets) of why multi-region inference helps latency-sensitive apps."}], "max_tokens": 120}'
```

alex-cs: customer agreed to run tests and will post results tomorrow morning.

sasha-eng-ml: thanks — once we have concrete before/after we can decide: rollback, add opt-out flag, or adjust the assistant_style mapping. also logging: please keep request ids. i'll pull telemetry for `avg tokens` and `hedging_phrase_count` across the last 24h.

maria-sr: noted. adding label `customer-escape-horizon` and assigning to INC-54321. :white_check_mark:

alex-cs: filing this as high-priority for the account; they have UI prompts that depend on the explanatory length. will follow up with the samples when FinServCo posts.

sasha-eng-ml: :thinking_face: quick note for the thread — if we make the assistant_style configurable per-customer that should avoid regressions. marking as product/eng discussion point.

maria-sr: thanks everyone. i'll update INC-54321 with the customer's outputs once received.
